title: 牛津学者Maryam Charity：蛇头借机牟利，移民风险加剧
speaker: Maryam Charity

segments.en: And the second thing, what I've noticed in terms of social media activity following the crossing is that there are two different types of new messaging going around.
segments.zh: 其次，我注意到越境事件后社交媒体上出现了两类新的信息。

segments.en: The first one is around those who've made it to Sota, narrating their experience, narrating how actually, now that they've made it, probably it's not worth it, you know,
segments.zh: 第一类是成功抵达的人分享经历，讲述抵达后可能并不值得。

segments.en: like they weren't able to eat for days, they weren't able to access any help.
segments.zh: 比如几天没吃饭，得不到任何帮助。

segments.en: And so there's that messaging going around as well.
And the other messaging that has searched in the past few days, unfortunately, are messages from smugglers who are treating this as a golden opportunity
segments.zh: 不幸的是，过去几天出现的另一类信息来自蛇头，他们视此为黄金机会。

segments.en: because now they know that those, you know, those words are going to be tighter in terms of immigration enforcement.
segments.zh: 因为他们知道移民执法将更加严格。

segments.en: So then that makes the, the, the opportunity for those migrants to cross on their own less
segments.zh: 这使得移民自行越境的机会减少。
